candidates.reason: Rebuilt for the square with a clear top-to-bottom flow and a strong headline. Three flaws: the legal line is promoted to near sub-copy size and wedged between the copy and the CTA, so it competes with the message; the sale banner and the logo sit on unrelated axes in the top corners; and the bottom half of the bottle is lost against the large dead area to its sides.

The portrait layout is pasted unchanged into the centre of the square at the original pixel sizes. The left and right thirds are empty, the bottle, headline and CTA are all undersized for the canvas, the legal line is microscopic, and the banner runs into the decorative circle. It was not rearranged for the new format.

The headline leads at the top with good scale, but 'day last' runs over the translucent circle. The legal line is again oversized and sits directly under the sub-copy. The bottle is pushed into the lower-middle with uneven gaps above and below it, and the logo floats far right of the banner with no shared alignment.

Fragmented. The logo and the bottle sit on separate left and right columns, and the shrunken sale banner floats mid-left on top of a circle, cut off from the product. The sub-copy, CTA and legal line are jammed into one bottom row, where the legal line reads as a peer of the CTA and sits on the busy red circle. The headline is ragged, and the large dead zone in the top-left makes the layout unbalanced.
